articles.title: Birthday Boy and His Partner Smash Their Way to the French Open Final!
articles.summary: Harri Heliovaara turned 37 and celebrated by winning a tennis match with his partner Henry Patten. They haven't lost a single set at the French Open and are now in the final!

articles.title: Art That Speaks Up: A New Show Lets Prints Do the Talking
articles.summary: An exhibition in Philadelphia called 'America Today' shows how artists use prints to talk about big ideas like fairness, history, and community. It features works from six print shops across the country.

articles.title: Sadie Sink Is About to Get Stuck in a Love Triangle—On TV!
articles.summary: Stranger Things star Sadie Sink will lead a new show called 'The Marriage Plot,' based on a book about three college grads figuring out love and life. It's coming to Hulu from the makers of 'Atlanta.'
